simple.meaning: צָרַב (tsârab) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to burn.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Ezekiel, beginning at Ezekiel 21:3. The surrounding contexts include righteousness, land, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צָרַב (H6866) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: צָרַב (tsârab) / H6866 is traced through Ezekiel 21:3 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H6866. tsarab [ צָרַב ] verb burn, scorch (Assyrian ƒarâbu , burn ; Frä Za iii. 52 Ba Es 32 compare Arabic be kindled, blaze ;; compare also זרב ); — Niph`al Perfect 3 plural consecutive וְנִצְרְבוּ Ezek 21:3 all faces shall be scorched.

occurrences.englishText: Tell the land of Israel, ‘Yahweh says: “Behold, I am against you, and will draw my sword out of its sheath, and will cut off from you the righteous and the wicked.
